title: HelioForge Energy Lab
shortDescription: Explore hybrid-energy layouts, learning activities, and bundled example results in an interactive research and education preview.
summary: Explore hybrid-system designs and inspect assumptions. The public browser edition shows bundled synthetic examples and the Terminal calculates new bounded 24-hour energy balances; advanced study models require the separate local Python application.
features: Browse hybrid-energy architectures and inspect their labeled system layouts.
Read architecture-linked lessons with experiment steps and self-check questions.
Review bundled scenario examples and compare visible energy assumptions and outcomes.
The public browser edition shows bundled synthetic examples; all 59 advanced study models run new calculations in the separate local Python application.
Inspect timelines, sensitivity maps, tariff inputs, signed local evidence and complete result exports.
The Terminal runs new deterministic, bounded 24-hour energy-balance cases in the browser; it uses a greedy policy and is not an optimizer.
Optional local external providers are separate, opt-in integrations; credentials and explicit consent are required where applicable. The public static preview makes no provider calls.
steps: Choose an architecture and inspect its components and stated assumptions.
Open a linked lesson and follow its experiment prompts and self-check.
Review a bundled scenario result and compare its energy and cost measures.
limitations: Bundled synthetic examples are precomputed outputs; the public browser edition does not calculate new study-model results from edited inputs.
The Terminal runs new deterministic, bounded 24-hour energy-balance cases in the browser; it uses a greedy policy and is not an optimizer.
The separate local Python application runs new calculations for the advanced study models and optimization.
Optional local external providers are separate, opt-in integrations; credentials and explicit consent are required where applicable. The public static preview makes no provider calls.
Models are educational research screens, not calibrated plant controls, forecasts, or investment advice.

faqs.question: What is a useful first step?
faqs.answer: Explore a bundled example. Open the public preview and inspect a labeled synthetic result.

faqs.question: Are the model results operational guidance?
faqs.answer: No. They are bounded research and learning examples with explicit assumptions, not a plant controller or calibrated digital twin.

faqs.question: How can I calculate a Terminal case?
faqs.answer: Calculate a bounded Terminal case. Open Scenario compare and use the Parametric energy workbench.

faqs.question: How can I run an advanced study?
faqs.answer: Set up advanced local calculations. Use the source setup guide to run the Python application on your machine.

runtimePatches.reason: Cloudflare browser edition always uses the existing snapshot mode; it has no Python API.
